summary: Every fact, assumption and dependency path a decision rests on is verified by a research subagent and gated before the question is asked or answered

options.description: Gate: research subagent writes an evidence ledger; checker refuses any unchecked entry; AskUserQuestion, cli-decisions add/answer and RFC resolution markers refuse without a passing ledger
Guidance only: keep the skill text, no gate

body: Operator direction 2026-11-27 in the planner session: unchecked facts and unverified dependencies are the biggest cause of decision problems; every fact must always be checked, and that must be gated so it happens before the rubric answers. Tightening (class a). Implemented by AISDLC-1451 (research subagent + evidence ledger + checker) and AISDLC-1452 (gates on AskUserQuestion, cli-decisions add/answer, RFC OQ resolution markers).
